title: Reverse K Subarrays
summary: Given an integer array nums of length n, where n is divisible by an integer k, partition the array into k contiguous subarrays of equal length.
statement: Given an integer array nums of length n, where n is divisible by an integer k, partition the array into k contiguous subarrays of equal length. Reverse each of these subarrays and return the resulting array.
constraints: nums is nonempty, k is positive, and len(nums) is divisible by k.
Partition nums into exactly k contiguous blocks of equal length.
Reverse every block and return their concatenation.
reference_solution:
def reverse_equal_blocks(nums,k):
    size=len(nums)//k;answer=nums[:]
    for start in range(0,len(nums),size):answer[start:start+size]=answer[start:start+size][::-1]
    return answer

hints: Exactly k equal blocks means each block has length n//k.
Walk block starts in steps of that length and reverse each slice.
Write the reversed slices into a copied array so the input contract stays clear.
The blocks are disjoint and cover every index once, so reversing each produces exactly the required concatenation.
